description: Darmstadtium is a synthetic chemical element with symbol Ds and atomic number 110. It is a d-block transactinide element in the 7th period and group 10 of the periodic table. It is extremely radioactive, with the most stable known isotope, darmstadtium-281, having a half-life of approximately 14 seconds.
characteristics: Darmstadtium is calculated to have similar properties to its lighter homologues nickel, palladium, and platinum. It is expected to be a very noble metal and a very heavy solid with a density of around 26–27 g/cm³. Its outer electron configuration is calculated to be 6d8 7s2, and its atomic radius is expected to be around 132 pm.
